report: SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular:Lateral menisküs anterior-posterior hornu ve gövde kesimde grade II dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Media menisküs diz eklem mesafesinden 5 mm mediale esktrüdedir. Menisküs posterior hornu ve gövde kesimde grade III dejenerasyon izlenmiştir. Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Anterior çapraz bağda diffüz incelme ve miksoid dejenerasyona sekonder sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Distal kuadriseps ve patellar tendonlar normaldir. Patella normal yerleşimlidir. Retinaküler devamsızlık yoktur.Gastroknemius medial krus proksimal insersio düzeyinde tendinozis ile uyumlu sinyal değişikliği izlenmiştir. Suprapatellar bursada ve diz eklem mesafesinde minimal sıvı artışı izlenmiştir. Diz eklemini oluşturan her üç kompartmanda santral-marjinal osteofit formasyonu izlenmiştir. Tibiofemoral eklem medialde eklem aralığında hafif daralma, ekleme komşu femoral ve tibial kartilajda incelme izlenmiştir. SONUÇ: Gonartroz. Medial menisküste mediale ekstrüzyon ve grade III meniskopati. Lateral menisküste grade II meniskopati. Anterior çapraz bağda diffüz inceleme ve miksoid dejenerasyon. Suprapatellar hafif bursit, diz ekleminde sinovit. Gastroknemius medial krusu tendinozisi.

SAĞ DİZ MRG. Tetkik protokolü: Çok düzlemli, çok sekanslı. Bulgular: Medial menisküste grade III dejenerasyon ve meniskal kökünde parsiyel yırtık ile uyumlu görünüm izlenmiştir. Medial menisküs hafif ekstrude görünümdedir. Lateral menisküste grade II dejenerasyon izlendi. Medial  kollateral ligamen çevresinde periligamentöz ödem ile uyumlu görünüm mevcuttur ( grade I sprain ). Ön çapraz bağda diffüz sinyal artışı izlendi (miksoid dejenerasyon).Arka çapraz bağ, lateral ve medial kollateral ligaman normaldir.Patellar kıkırdakta belirgin incelme ve komşu kemikte subkondrial kemik iliği ödemi ve milimetrik kist izlendi ( grade II kondromalazi ).Suprapatellar bursada her iki reseslerde hafif sıvı artışları izlendi. Prepatellar düzeyde cilt altı yağlı dokuda ödematöz görünüm mevcuttur.Patellar tendon tibia yapışma düzeyinde hafif fokal sinyal artışı ve infrapatellar bursada minimal sıvı artışı izlendi. Gastrocnemius medial krus tendonunun femur yapışma düzeyinde kalınlık ve sinyal artışı izlendi.Tibiofemoral eklem medial düzeyde eklem mesafesinde daralma,  medial kondilde subkondrial milimetrik kist ve kemik iliği ödemi, bu düzeyde medial kondilde subkondrial kemik iliği ödemi ve milimetrik kist izlendi. Bu düzeyde kartilajlarda hafif incelmeler izlendi.  Tibia interkondiler tüberkül ACL yapışma düzeyinde subkondrial kemik iliği ödemi, milimetrik kistler izlendi.

Medial meniscus tear.

Exam Date and Time: [DATE] [TIME]
Indication: Right knee pain and instability
Comparison: Radiographs [DATE]

TECHNIQUE:
MRI of the right knee was performed on a 1.5 Tesla system with a dedicated knee coil in three planes (axial, sagittal, and coronal), using a standard non-contrast protocol.

FINDINGS:
OSSEOUS STRUCTURES:
Alignment is anatomic. No acute fracture or bone bruise. Background marrow signal is normal without infiltrative marrow process. No aggressive osseous lesions.

JOINT SPACE:
Moderate joint effusion. No intra-articular bodies. No Baker's cyst.

MEDIAL COMPARTMENT:
Medial meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Medial compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

LATERAL COMPARTMENT:
Lateral meniscus: Normal in morphology and signal.
Lateral compartment cartilage: No focal cartilage defects.

PATELLOFEMORAL COMPARTMENT:
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: Mild loss of cartilage along the lateral femoral trochlea with prominent subchondral marrow edema. No reciprocal marrow edema within the patella. There is mild heterogeneity of the patellar cartilage no small cartilage fissure in the central femoral trochlea.

CRUCIATE LIGAMENTS:
Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): Normal with both bundles intact.
Posterior cruciate ligament (PCL): Normal.

COLLATERAL LIGAMENTS & POSTEROLATERAL CORNER:
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Lateral collateral ligament (LCL) complex: Normal.
Posterolateral corner structures: Normal.

EXTENSOR MECHANISM:
Distal quadriceps tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Patella tendon: No tendinosis or tear.
Medial patellofemoral ligament (MPFL) and patellar retinacula: Normal.
Patellofemoral tracking: No edema in superolateral Hoffa's fat pad. No lateral patellar tilt or translation. No patella alta. Normal patellar and trochlear morphology. Normal tibial tubercle-trochlear groove (TT-TG) distance measuring 13 mm.

MUSCLES/TENDONS:
No acute muscle strain or muscle atrophy. Visualized tendons not previously discussed are intact without tendinosis or tear.

SOFT TISSUES:
No soft tissue mass. Normal popliteal neurovascular bundle. Mild edema in the prepatellar subcutaneous fat.

IMPRESSION:

1. Moderate knee joint effusion.

2. Mild patellofemoral osteoarthritis with prominent subchondral marrow edema along the lateral femoral trochlea.

MRI LEFT KNEE:

INDICATION:    Pain worse with bending greater than 10 degrees. Swelling for 6 months.

PRIOR IMAGING: None.
.
TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact and unremarkable apart from very subtle increased signal seen in the proximal patellar tendon laterally. There is associated focal edema seen within Hoffa's fat pad inferior to the lateral aspect of the lower pole of patella also involving the lateral edge of the patellar tendon. Findings are consistent with mild lateral patellar tendinosis. Edema in Hoffa's fat may be associated with extensor mechanism impingement.

There is focal signal change and irregularity of the articular cartilage of the medial facet of patella consistent with moderate chondrosis. The remainder of the articular cartilage of patella is well-maintained. The trochlear articular cartilage is also reasonably preserved.

The TT-TG distance measures about 1 cm, within normal limits.

The lateral meniscus is intact. The articular cartilage of the lateral joint compartment is well-maintained.

The medial meniscus appears intact with no surfacing tear demonstrated. Immediately adjacent to the posterior horn of medial meniscus tracking along the joint margin posteriorly from the posterior root attachment medially to the medial joint margin deep to the semimembranosus and semitendinosus tendons there is a large multiloculated parameniscal cyst. This measures about 3.7 cm in length with short axis measurements of up to 1.2 x 0.9 cm.

The anterior cruciate ligament, posterior cruciate ligament, medial collateral ligament and lateral collateral ligament complex are intact.

There is no Baker's cyst or knee effusion demonstrated.

INTERPRETATION: 

Moderate chondromalacia patella.

Mild patellar tendinosis with edema in Hoffa's fat pad laterally. The edema may indicate presence of extensor mechanism impingement of Hoffa's fat pad.

There is a large para meniscal cyst closely associated with the posterior horn and body of medial meniscus. There is no discernible, associated medial meniscal tear identified.

No evidence of internal derangement.

FINDINGS:

Fluid:
Mild to moderate effusion. No popliteal cyst.

Medial compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament, cartilage):
There is mild irregularity and thickening of the medial collateral ligament with partial discontinuity, suggestive of high-grade tear.
There is no evidence of meniscal injury

Lateral compartment (meniscus, collateral ligament complex, cartilage):
Normal.

Intercondylar compartment (anterior and posterior cruciate ligaments):
There is irregularity and increased signal intensity within the anterior cruciate ligament, which also appears discontinuous. Complete tear is suspected.
Posterior cruciate ligament is intact.

Anterior compartment (extensor mechanism, cartilage, Hoffa's fat pad):
Normal

Bones:
There is bone contusion involving lateral femoral epicondyle, medial femoral condyle and lateral aspect of the tibial plateau. There is very mild subchondral impaction in the lateral femoral epicondyle which could represent microtrabecular fracture.

Muscles and neurovascular structures:
Normal.

Other findings:
There is mild increased signal intensity within the soft tissue lateral to the lateral femoral condyle, likely presents post traumatic changes.

CONCLUSION:
1.Complete tear of the anterior cruciate ligament
2.High-grade, likely complete tear of the medial collateral ligament.
3.Bone contusion involving lateral and medial femoral epicondyle and lateral aspect of the tibial plateau with possible microtrabecular fracture involving lateral femoral epicondyle.

Posterolateral ve posteromedyal köşe yapıları korunmuş. Medyal menisküste kova sapı yırtığı ve gövde-arka boynuz bileşkesinde inferiyor eklem yüzüne uzanan horizontal-oblik yırtık izleniyor. Clinical information: Stiffness in the left knee after tripped on street and banged on cement. Rule out fat pad impingement or meniscal pathology.

Technique: Unenhanced multiplanar multiphase MRI of the left knee performed and 3.0 Tesla MRI scanner.

Findings:
There is a complex degenerative tearing of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus extending into the tibial meniscal surface. There is slight meniscal extrusion. The lateral meniscus is intact.

The cruciate and collateral ligaments are intact. Extensor mechanism of the knee is unremarkable.

There are no deep cartilage defects in the medial and lateral femorotibial joint compartment. There are no deep cartilage defects in the patellofemoral joint compartment. There is patchy bone marrow edema involving the midportion and inferior patellar pole without focal fracture line.

The infrapatellar fat pad is unremarkable. There is mild joint effusion. There are no intra-articular bodies. There is a low volume Baker's cyst.

The visualized muscle bulk is unremarkable.

Conclusion:
1. Patchy bone marrow edema at the inferior patellar pole without focal fracture line, most probably representing bone contusion after a previous trauma.
2. Degenerative tearing of the medial meniscus as described in detail above.
3. No deep cartilage defects.

Артикулиращият ставен хрущял на фемура е с нарушена конгруентност. Вижда се дефект в хрущяла на медиалния феморален кондил на протежение от около 10мм в зоната на максимално натоварване, без субхондрални промени в костта.  Свободният фрагмент от хрущяла е с размери 10,7/5мм и се изобразява зад мастната тъкан на Хофа сред излива, пред латералния кондил на фемура. Нормално изобразяване на латералния менискус.
